headline: Rexel Posts Q3 Sales Surge While Shares Drop 3.1%
summary: Rexel reported a surge in third-quarter 2026 sales, though its stock fell 3.1% following the earnings release.
why: Rexel is a global distributor of electrical supplies and equipment. Stock price reactions to rising sales figures often reflect pre-existing valuation expectations or margin concerns.

impacts.name: Rexel
impacts.why: Profit-taking or forward-looking margin concerns can cause stock prices to drop despite positive quarterly sales growth.

why_moved: Equities can pull back following strong top-line reports if investors have already priced in the expected growth or focus on underlying profitability metrics.
